001package iscteiul.ista.battleship;
002
003/**
004 * Defines ship bearings and their lowercase command characters.
005 * West uses {@code o}, from the Portuguese word {@code oeste}.
006 *
007 * @author fba
008 */
009public enum Compass {
010    /** North, represented by {@code n}. */
011    NORTH('n'),
012    /** South, represented by {@code s}. */
013    SOUTH('s'),
014    /** East, represented by {@code e}. */
015    EAST('e'),
016    /** West, represented by {@code o}. */
017    WEST('o'),
018    /** An unrecognised direction, represented by {@code u}. */
019    UNKNOWN('u');
020
021    /** Character used to represent this bearing in commands and output. */
022    private final char c;
023
024    /**
025     * Associates a bearing with its command character.
026     *
027     * @param c the character representing the bearing
028     */
029    Compass(char c) {
030        this.c = c;
031    }
032
033    /**
034     * Returns the character representing this bearing.
035     *
036     * @return the lowercase direction character
037     */
038    public char getDirection() {
039        return c;
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * Returns this bearing as a one-character string.
044     *
045     * @return the direction character as a string
046     */
047    @Override
048    public String toString() {
049        return "" + c;
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * Converts a lowercase command character to a bearing.
054     *
055     * @param ch {@code n}, {@code s}, {@code e} or {@code o}
056     * @return the corresponding bearing, or {@link #UNKNOWN} for any other character
057     */
058    static Compass charToCompass(char ch) {
059        Compass bearing;
060        switch (ch) {
061            case 'n':
062                bearing = NORTH;
063                break;
064            case 's':
065                bearing = SOUTH;
066                break;
067            case 'e':
068                bearing = EAST;
069                break;
070            case 'o':
071                bearing = WEST;
072                break;
073            default:
074                bearing = UNKNOWN;
075        }
076
077        return bearing;
078    }
079}
